{{short description|none}}
{{main|Large cardinal}}

This page includes a list of [[large cardinal]] properties in the mathematical field of [[set theory]]. It is arranged roughly in order of the consistency strength of the [[axiom]] asserting the existence of [[cardinal number|cardinals]] with the given property. Existence of a cardinal number ''κ'' of a given type implies the existence of cardinals of most of the types listed above that type, and for most listed cardinal descriptions ''φ'' of lesser consistency strength, [[Von Neumann universe|''V''<sub>''κ''</sub>]] satisfies "there is an unbounded class of cardinals satisfying ''φ''".

The following table usually arranges cardinals in order of [[equiconsistency#Consistency strength|consistency strength]], with size of the cardinal used as a tiebreaker. In a few cases (such as strongly compact cardinals) the exact consistency strength is not known and the table uses the current best guess.

* "Small" cardinals: 0, 1, 2, ..., <math>\aleph_0, \aleph_1</math>,..., <math>\kappa  = \aleph_{\kappa}</math>, ... (see [[Aleph number]]); the height of the [[Minimal model (set theory)|minimal transitive model]] of ZFC
* [[worldly cardinal]]s
* weakly and strongly [[inaccessible cardinal|inaccessible]], [[inaccessible cardinal#α-inaccessible cardinals and hyper-inaccessible cardinals|α-inaccessible]], and hyper inaccessible cardinals
* weakly and strongly [[Mahlo cardinal|Mahlo]], α-[[Mahlo cardinal|Mahlo]], and hyper Mahlo cardinals.
* [[reflecting cardinal|reflecting]] cardinals
* pseudo uplifting cardinals, uplifting cardinals<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Hamkins |first=Joel David |last2=Johnstone |first2=Thomas A. |date=2014-05-01 |title=Resurrection axioms and uplifting cardinals |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/s00153-014-0374-y |journal=Archive for Mathematical Logic |language=en |volume=53 |issue=3 |pages=463–485 |doi=10.1007/s00153-014-0374-y |issn=1432-0665|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
* [[weakly compact cardinal|weakly compact]] (= Π{{su|p=1|b=1}}-indescribable), [[indescribable cardinal|Π{{su|p=''m''|b=''n''}}-indescribable]], [[indescribable cardinal|totally indescribable]] cardinals, [[indescribable cardinal|&nu;-indescribable]] cardinals
* [[unfoldable cardinal|λ-unfoldable]], [[unfoldable cardinal|unfoldable]] cardinals, [[shrewd cardinal|λ-shrewd]], [[shrewd cardinal|shrewd]] cardinals, strongly uplifting cardinals (not clear how these relate to each other).
* [[subtle cardinal|ethereal cardinals]], [[subtle cardinal]]s
* [[almost ineffable cardinal|almost ineffable]], [[ineffable cardinal|ineffable]], [[ineffable cardinal|''n''-ineffable]], [[ineffable cardinal|totally ineffable]] cardinals
* 1-[[iterable cardinal]], [[remarkable cardinal]], [[virtually extendible cardinal]], [[iterable cardinal|γ-iterable cardinal for 2≤γ≤&omega;]], [[virtually rank-into-rank cardinal]], &omega;-[[Erdős cardinal]]
* &lambda;-[[iterable cardinal]], &lambda;-[[Erdős cardinal]] (for &omega;+1≤&lambda;<&omega;<sub>1</sub>)
* [[Silver cardinal]], [[zero sharp|0<sup>#</sup>]] (not a cardinal), &omega;<sub>1</sub>-[[iterable cardinal]], &omega;<sub>1</sub>-[[Erdős cardinal]]
* [[almost Ramsey cardinal|almost Ramsey]], [[Jónsson cardinal|Jónsson]], [[Rowbottom cardinal|Rowbottom]], [[Ramsey cardinal|Ramsey]], [[ineffably Ramsey cardinal|ineffably Ramsey]], completely Ramsey, strongly Ramsey, super Ramsey cardinals, Magidor cardinals<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Garti |first=Shimon |last2=Hayut |first2=Yair |last3=Shelah |first3=Saharon |date=5 May 2017 |title=On the verge of inconsistency: Magidor cardinals and Magidor filters |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/s11856-017-1510-2 |journal=[[Israel Journal of Mathematics]] |language=en |volume=220 |issue=1 |pages=89–102 |arxiv=1508.04903 |doi=10.1007/s11856-017-1510-2 |issn=0021-2172}}</ref>
* [[measurable cardinal]]s,  [[zero dagger|0<sup>†</sup>]]
* [[strong cardinal|λ-strong]],  [[strong cardinal|strong]] cardinals, [[tall cardinal|tall]] cardinals
* [[Woodin cardinal|Woodin]], [[weakly hyper-Woodin cardinal|weakly hyper-Woodin]], [[Shelah cardinal|Shelah]], [[hyper-Woodin cardinal|hyper-Woodin]] cardinals
* [[superstrong cardinal]]s (=1-superstrong; for ''n''-superstrong for ''n''&ge;2 see further down.)
* [[subcompact cardinal|subcompact]], [[strongly compact cardinal|strongly compact]] (Woodin< strongly compact&le;supercompact), [[supercompact cardinal|supercompact]], [[hypercompact cardinal|hypercompact]] cardinals
* [[extendible cardinal|η-extendible]], [[extendible cardinal|extendible]] cardinals
* almost high jump cardinals
* [[Vopěnka cardinal]]s, Shelah for supercompactness, [[high jump cardinal]]s, super high jump cardinals
* ''n''-[[superstrong cardinal|superstrong (''n''&ge;2)]], ''n''-[[huge cardinal|almost huge]], ''n''-[[huge cardinal|super almost huge]], ''n''-[[huge cardinal|huge]], ''n''-[[huge cardinal|superhuge]] cardinals  (1-huge=huge, etc.)
* [[exacting cardinals]], [[ultraexacting cardinals]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Aguilera |first=Juan Pablo |last2=Bagaria |first2=Joan |last3=Goldberg |first3=Gabriel |last4=Lücke |first4=Philipp |date=2025-09-12 |title=Large cardinals beyond HOD |url=https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.10254v1 |access-date=2026-04-22 |website=arXiv.org |language=en}}</ref>
* [[Wholeness axiom]], [[rank-into-rank]] (Axioms I3, I2, I1, and I0)
The following even stronger large cardinal properties are not consistent with the [[axiom of choice]], but their existence has not yet been refuted in [[ZFC|ZF]] alone (that is, without use of the axiom of choice). 
*[[weakly Reinhardt cardinal]], [[Reinhardt cardinal]], proto-Berkeley cardinal, [[Berkeley cardinal]], [[super Reinhardt cardinal]], [[totally Reinhardt cardinal]], [[club Berkeley cardinal]], limit club Berkeley cardinal<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Bagaria |first=Joan |last2=Koellner |first2=Peter |last3=Woodin |first3=W. Hugh |date=2019 |title=Large Cardinals Beyond Choice |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/26788522 |journal=The Bulletin of Symbolic Logic |volume=25 |issue=3 |pages=283–318 |issn=1079-8986}}</ref>
Many of these large cardinals axioms also have ''virtual'' versions.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Gitman |first=Victoria |last2=Schindler |first2=Ralf |date=2018-12-01 |title=Virtual large cardinals |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168007218300897 |journal=Annals of Pure and Applied Logic |series=Logic Colloquium 2015 |volume=169 |issue=12 |pages=1317–1334 |doi=10.1016/j.apal.2018.08.005 |issn=0168-0072|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
